policies.label: Synthetic discretionary baseline
policies.description: Reference-only replay of matched synthetic comp actions; missing comp records remain unknown rather than being labeled under-recovery.

policies.label: Tiered standardization
policies.description: Select the highest issue-fit tier-appropriate gesture without public context or cost optimization.

policies.label: Guardrailed recovery
policies.description: Require a robust recovery-fit margin first, then select the lowest midpoint-cost gesture; reserve direct refunds for cases without an adequate alternative.

policies.label: Recovery first
policies.description: Prioritize issue fit and guest-perceived value after operational constraints, using cost only as a tie-breaker.

policies.label: Intelligent generosity
policies.description: Use the current context-aware balance of recovery fit, estimated cost, guest value, demand, property fit, and operational pressure.
